schema_note: 实施卡片五要素（当前基线—准入条件—责任角色—验收指标—退出机制）；全部为概念建议/设计目标值，责任主体待协商指定，验收指标待专项深化正式化。

cards.current_baseline_zh: 概念设计；公开报道显示南段已有市级立项批复（来源待登记复核）
cards.current_baseline_en: Concept design; public reporting indicates municipal approval on the southern segment (pending registry review)
entry_conditions_zh: 跨干路接口交通组织方案
cards.responsible_roles_zh: 属地主管部门 + 实施主体（待协商指定）+ 慢行运营方
cards.responsible_roles_en: Local authority + implementing body (to be named) + slow-mobility operator
acceptance_metrics_zh: 步行/骑行主线连续率（目标 100%）
六站厅 5 分钟步行覆盖率
cards.exit_mechanism_zh: 分段可逆：未达标段按折返协议退回上一稳定状态并公示
cards.exit_mechanism_en: Segment-wise reversible: non-compliant segments revert under the Switchback Protocol with public explanation

entry_conditions_zh: 站厅用地与轨道接驳协议
cards.responsible_roles_zh: 站厅运营方 + 属地主管部门
acceptance_metrics_zh: 服务台人工问询响应时长
cards.exit_mechanism_zh: 街具与设施可撤回，广场功能可恢复
cards.exit_mechanism_en: Street furniture reversible; plaza functions restorable

cards.name_zh: 清华园站厅展示廊概念改造
cards.current_baseline_zh: 概念意向（文保要求优先，须以文物部门正式公布为准）
cards.current_baseline_en: Conceptual intent (heritage protection first; subject to the relics authority)
cards.responsible_roles_zh: 运营方 + 文保协商机制（待建立）
cards.responsible_roles_en: Operator + heritage consultation mechanism (to be established)
cards.exit_mechanism_zh: 展陈系统整体可逆，可随时恢复站房原状
cards.exit_mechanism_en: Exhibition system fully reversible; station building restorable at any time

cards.name_zh: 中央绿谷开放创新界面
acceptance_metrics_zh: 黑客马拉松/发布活动容量

cards.name_zh: 大钟寺智能原生商业街区更新
cards.current_baseline_zh: 概念设计（权属复杂、改造主体多元）
cards.current_baseline_en: Concept design (complex property rights, multiple renewal actors)
entry_conditions_zh: 权属协商与商户参与同意
cards.responsible_roles_zh: 商业运营方 + 商户联盟（待组建）
cards.responsible_roles_en: Commercial operator + merchant alliance (to be formed)
cards.exit_mechanism_zh: 业态可置换回退，以功能置换为主的更新天然可逆
cards.exit_mechanism_en: Formats swappable back; conversion-led renewal is inherently reversible

cards.name_zh: 中部居住区渐进更新与口袋公园
cards.name_en: Central residential gradual renewal with pocket parks
entry_conditions_zh: 加梯与小微空间改造审批
cards.responsible_roles_zh: 属地 + 社区 + 居民自治组织
cards.exit_mechanism_zh: 轻量手法（加梯/口袋公园）天然可逆、可调整
cards.exit_mechanism_en: Light-touch measures inherently reversible and adjustable

cards.name_zh: 清河—小月河滨水绿带连通
cards.current_baseline_zh: 概念设计；公开报道提及公园二期鱼骨慢行通道已连清河侧（待登记复核）
cards.current_baseline_en: Concept design; public reporting mentions phase-2 fish-bone links reaching the Qing River side (pending registry review)
cards.responsible_roles_zh: 水务主管部门 + 园林实施方
cards.exit_mechanism_zh: 植被与软质岸线可恢复

cards.name_zh: 端侧算力节点与新型基础设施示范
entry_conditions_zh: 数据合规与网络安全审查
cards.responsible_roles_zh: 基础设施运营方（待协商指定）
cards.exit_mechanism_zh: 设备可整体拆除，数据可清除并出具销毁记录
cards.exit_mechanism_en: Equipment fully removable; data erasable with destruction records

boundary_zh: 全部卡片为概念建议；基线均为未实测的设计起点，验收指标为建议目标值，正式指标以专项深化为准；不预设资金安排与政府承诺。
boundary_en: All cards are concept proposals; baselines are unmeasured design starting points, acceptance metrics are suggested targets pending specialised deepening; no funding arrangements or government commitments presumed.
